Separate eye/eyelid/iris/brow and fine hair detail; no bangs fused into the eyes. Loose black short sleeve outer shirt over pale white long sleeves, white shorts and black lace-up ankle boots. Finely observed anime character integrated with rich warm textiles/wood and shared sunlight, natural bench/floor contact shadows.
